fusions.name: Clean the Plate
fusions.desc: Spears the first enemy within 4 tiles and deals 18 piercing damage. 30% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over the following 6 seconds. Usable only on a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Carving Round
fusions.desc: Carves around you, dealing 6 slashing damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Marrow and Gristle
fusions.desc: Picks over every body within 6 tiles, up to 5; each restores 7% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
